{"name": "run_python", "arguments": {"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/penguins.csv')

# Compute mean flipper length by species
mean_flipper_by_species = df.groupby('species')['flipper_length_mm'].mean()

# Find the species with the highest mean flipper length
best_species = mean_flipper_by_species.idxmax()
mean_value = mean_flipper_by_species.max()

print(f'Mean flipper length by species:\n{mean_flipper_by_species}')
print(f'\nSpecies with highest mean flipper length: {best_species} ({mean_value:.2f} mm)')}}
